scope: Native headless input events and focus handlers against real authoritative movement/dialogue
limitations: Injected events do not establish physical controller, OS focus switching or visual acceptance.

Checks: Opposing held directions did not manufacture a neutral release.
Fresh movement resumed after all held directions returned to neutral.
Keyboard repeat did not duplicate pause; controller Cancel unwound pause.
Focus return did not replay a held movement key.
Small stick drift stayed inside the circular deadzone.
A deliberate diagonal kept the existing circular-deadzone movement behavior.
Dismissing dialogue did not release held movement into gameplay.
Escape and controller B close dialogue first without leaking the event into world actions.
